title: Bias in News Summarization: Measures, Pitfalls and Corpora

bias_targets.methodology: Creating mutations of real-world news documents by substituting names, titles, and pronouns with male or female variants, and evaluating summarizer outputs using metrics for word list inclusion, entity inclusion, entity hallucination bias, and representational distinguishability.

Substituting first and last names in the source documents with stereotypically Black and White names from a US census dictionary to evaluate entity inclusion bias and representational distinguishability in the generated summaries.

Constructing additional datasets with combinations of perceived entity race (using stereotypically Black and White names) and binary gender assignments to evaluate interaction effects on inclusion bias and distinguishability.
